name: SHAPE PHX Planning and Permitting Portal
known_limitations: SHAPE PHX is a portal for permits, licenses, zoning applications, code modifications, plan reviews, and inspections, but records must be selected and interpreted individually.
source_owner: City of Phoenix Planning and Development Department
automation_notes: Manual portal review required; use only specific selected permit, zoning, plan review, or inspection records for local conclusions.
notes: Phase 55E recheck moved the source URL to the official City of Phoenix landing page and preserved the interactive portal as the docket-search URL. The city states that commercial plan review, permitting, and inspections moved to SHAPE PHX effective April 27, 2026.
